description: Web Isolation eliminates web threats and solves the challenge of providing secured access to the uncategorized and potentially risky web. Web Isolation creates a secure execution environment between users and the web. By executing web sessions remotely and only sending safe rendering information to users’ browsers, Web Isolation eliminates any web-borne threats from reaching user’s devices.
